title: Support switching input language via mouse wheel on applet
line: Scrolling over the Input Method Panel's input method icon now switches to the next or previous input method.
explanation: The Input Method Panel widget only reacted to clicks: the wheel did nothing over its icons, unlike the pager, task manager or clock. The kimpanel protocol has no "next input method" call, the input method only sends its list of input methods as a menu when its status icon is triggered. Scrolling over the input method icon (fcitx's /Fcitx/im or IBus's /IBus/Logo) now requests that list without showing it, finds the current entry (a "checked" hint, or the entry whose name matches the icon's label or tooltip) and activates the next or previous one, wrapping around.

commits.message:
applets/kimpanel: switch input method with the mouse wheel

Scrolling over the input method icon did nothing, while other panel
widgets like the pager use the wheel to switch. Now it asks the input
method for its list and activates the next or previous entry instead.

BUG: 340606

media.caption: Pure master: scrolling down three times and up once over the input method icon (US) does nothing.
With the fix: scrolling down goes US → DE → Pinyin → US, scrolling up goes back to Pinyin.
